risk.publisher: NC State University ERM Initiative + AICPA
risk.title: 2026 State of Risk Oversight
risk.population: Executives and board-level leaders across organization types

metrics.label: Reported unique strategic or competitive advantage from risk management
Said risk volume and complexity had increased over five years
Described risk oversight as mature or robust

risk.verification: Publisher-indexed study summary and AICPA release; figures are separate survey items.
risk.limits: Self-reported perceptions, not a test of realized performance or causality. Not Kemenkeu-specific evidence.

audit.title: Global Internal Audit Study 2023
audit.population: Internal audit leaders, board/business respondents, and second-line risk/compliance leaders
audit.label: Believed internal audit lacked strong alignment with other lines on key risks and problems
audit.verification: Publisher web study and PDF page 19; overall sample on PDF page 2.
audit.limits: The 49% applies to the business-executive subgroup; its item-level denominator is not stated in the public summary. The overall sample is not the denominator for that percentage. Measures perceived alignment, not audit failure.

paper.title: Four Ways to Improve Risk Reporting
paper.quote: Risk reporting is often unconnected with business strategy and performance
paper.verification: Journal abstract; methodology and observed weaknesses described in the author's 2025 ISB interview. Full paywalled article was not used.
paper.limits: Qualitative field evidence explains mechanisms; it does not estimate how common these problems are across all organizations.
